Name: Pokemon Day Care - Giftbox
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=5][b]Pokemon Day Care - Gift Box[/b][/size]

The gift box becomes a Poke Ball. Open it and it pops open like a Ball releasing its Pokemon.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Replaces the gift box sprite and its opening animation
[*]Shows everywhere the game uses the gift box: the welcome gift on day one, and gifts from events and other mods
[*]No settings
[/list]
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[/list]
[b]Installation[/b]
Unzip into your Mods folder. Safe to add or remove at any time, it only changes images.
[b]Updating from an older version:[/b] the mod ID changed to Parme.PokemonDayCareGiftbox. Delete the old folder before installing this one.

[b]Pokemon Day Care series[/b]
This mod is part of the Pokemon Day Care series but does not need the main mod.

Downloads.Description:
Delete the old folder before installing; your settings go back to default.
Use it with or without Pokemon Day Care expansion
